races.display_title: Irish Stallion Farms European Breeders Fund Bold Lad Sprint Handicap (Premier Handicap)
races.verdict: A fiercely competitive sprint, but KEKE goes well here and remains on a fair mark with a good-value claimer booked so could be worth chancing. The unexposed Bear on The Run is a big danger, with Staysound Susie and Dmaniac also of firm interest, particularly if the rain arrives. KEKE BEAR ON THE RUN (IRE) STAYSOUND SUSIE (IRE)

races.display_title: Loud Hire Nursery
races.verdict: Q T BOY shaped well on his nursery debut at Chepstow 15 days ago, seeing out the trip despite the soft ground, and he is taken to go one better now upped to 1m. Q T BOY MAGICAL LIFE THUNDA STRUCK (IRE)

races.display_title: Loud Hire Production Services Bath Summer Sprint Series Final Handicap
races.verdict: A fiendishly competitive sprint which can go the way of MORTUBO , who holds a class edge over most of these and the form of her Newmarket second back in June has worked out very well (had 3 next-time-out winners behind her). Big Time Rascal has made a cracking start for new connections so he's put forward as the main threat, with Geeman, Legendsoftheland and Neptune Legend just a trio of others worth considering, too. MORTUBO (IRE) BIG TIME RASCAL GEEMANN
races.betting_forecast: Mortubo (9/2), Geemann (6/1), Dark Sun (8/1), Legendsoftheland (8/1), Big Time Rascal (8/1), Sub Thirteen (10/1), Southbank (10/1), The Feminine Urge (10/1), My Boy Jack (12/1), Honour Your Dreams (16/1), Sisters In The Sky (16/1), Neptune Legend (16/1), Rinky Tinky Tinky (20/1), Sioux Warrior (20/1), Coast (33/1), Nordic Glory (33/1), Cougar Force (50/1)

races.display_title: Loud Hire Supporting Bath Racecourse Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict: TONAL thrived on the all-weather last winter and his Ffos Las success in June showed he's well treated from his lower turf mark. Up 5 lb but looks capable of defying it if returning from a break in top form. Blue Hero has 11 course wins here and went agonisingly close over C&D 11 days ago so looks sure to go well, while Decalogue improved further at Salisbury recently and wears first-time cheekpieces, which could help here. TONAL (FR) BLUE HERO (CAN) DECALOGUE (USA)

races.display_title: Land Of Lights Festival At Gullivers Handicap
races.verdict: ADRESTIA was mixing it in much better company this time last season and following signs of a revival at Goodwood in late-July, she could well capitalise on a drop in grade. Unexposed 3-y-o sprinter Hypnotised is feared most, with Canon's House , Maelstrom , Jer Batt and The Man other likely players in a wide-open sprint handicap. ADRESTIA HYPNOTISED CANON'S HOUSE
races.betting_forecast: Hypnotised (7/2), Adrestia (6/1), Maelstrom (6/1), The Man (8/1), Fortification (8/1), Equity Law (10/1), Jer Batt (10/1), Wheels Of Fire (12/1), Ancient State (14/1), Canon's House (16/1), Henrythenate (20/1), Novelette (25/1), Changeofmind (25/1), Venture Capital (33/1), Novello Lad (33/1), Paddy's Day (33/1)

races.display_title: I Love Julie Parkes Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict: TIVA represents an in-form yard and arrives on the back of several solid efforts, including a recent Musselburgh win. The booking of a useful 5 lb claimer is an added bonus and she is taken to notch a fifth career success. Call Margot took a step back in the right direction and rates the main threat if building on that, while Hiya Maite is on a long losing run but well treated on the pick of his form. TIVA (IRE) CALL MARGOT (IRE) HIYA MAITE
